text: DSH Security Scan 是面向 DSH 网页端的项目扫描工作台，在侧栏提供扫描任务和报告界面，并注册会话内扫描工具。它可扫描项目代码、生成可离线查看的报告、查询依赖公告，并把选定结果交给 DSH 会话复核或继续处理。适合希望在 DSH 中集中查看扫描任务和报告的开发者。依赖查询会向 OSV 发送包名与版本。

DSH Security Scan adds a project scanning workbench to the DSH web sidebar. It creates scan tasks and offline reports, looks up dependency advisories, and connects selected results to a DSH session for follow-up. Dependency lookups send package names and versions to OSV.

DSH Security Scan 的功能「项目扫描与报告」：从 DSH 工作台创建扫描任务，并在侧栏查看生成的报告；会话工具也可启动扫描。
DSH Security Scan 的功能「会话衔接」：从会话启动扫描任务，返回任务标识，并将后续复核工作接入当前 DSH 会话。
DSH Security Scan 使用依赖公告查询时，会将包名和版本发送到 api.osv.dev；README说明不会发送源码。

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · 能做什么：- **静态扫描，不用模型 Token**：29 条内置 Semgrep 规则，覆盖 Flask、Django、Express、Koa、Next.js、React、Gin、Echo、net/http 和常见 SQL / HTTP 库中的命令注入、SQL 注入、XSS、SSRF、路径穿越、开放跳转、不安全反序列化、关闭 TLS 校验、JWT 不验签等问题。
- **密钥与依赖**：Gitleaks 查找疑似凭据；OSV 查询已知依赖漏洞，支持 npm / pnpm 锁文件、go.sum、requirements 和 uv.lock。
- **只读运行时检查**：对你授权的服务地址发送最多 12 个同源 GET 请求，检查安全响应头、Cookie 属性、CORS、调试页面和 `.git` / `.env` 暴露。
- **AI 复核（可选）**：用 DSH 里已配置的模型读取源码、追踪调用者，确认或排除候选问题，并补充越权、租户隔离等规则难以发现的风险；每条结论都引用实际读过的代码行。
- **修复闭环**：在报告里勾选问题，一键交给 DSH 会话，默认在独立分支里修复并验证；修完自动复扫，对比哪些问题仍然存在，剩下的可以继续下一轮。
- **误报排除**：在报告里标记，或让修复会话核实后经你审批排除；后续扫描自动隐藏，相关代码改动后会重新出现。
- **报告与集成**：离线 HTML、JSON 和 SARIF；每次自动对比同一任务的上一份报告，也可以对比目标分支，只看新增的问题；`dsh-security` CLI、Git hooks 和 CI 复用同一套规则。

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · 安装：需要官方 DSH **0.2.1-rc.5**，其他版本尚未验证。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @shamcleren/dsh-security-scan@0.18.0
```

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · 安装：也可以在 DSH 侧栏的「插件 → 添加插件」里填写 `@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan@0.18.0`。命令里写明版本号，是因为 DSH 使用的 pnpm 默认不自动选用发布不到一天的版本；升级时把版本号换成[发布记录](https://github.com/shamcleren/dsh-security-scan/releases)里的新版本。npm 包与 Release 中的 `.tgz` 是同一份文件，也可以直接用 Release 地址安装。官方桌面版把 `web` 换成实际使用的 `desktop` profile。安装后重启 DSH，侧栏上方会出现「安全扫描」。首次启用时，插件会自动下载并校验 Semgrep、Gitleaks 和独立的 Python，放在 `~/.dsh/security-scan/toolchains/`，不改动系统环境。

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · 第一次扫描：1. 点击侧栏「安全扫描」，选择「新建任务」。
2. 代码来源选「本地目录」并填写项目路径，或选「仓库地址」填写 Git 地址和分支。只想跑规则、不用模型时，取消「启用 Agentic AI」。
3. 点击「保存并运行」。完成后在「历史报告」中打开报告，勾选要处理的问题，选择「在会话中修复」或「标记为误报」。

也可以在已选择项目的 DSH 会话里直接说：「用安全扫描插件扫描当前项目，并复核候选漏洞」。命令行扫描：

```sh
~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/.bin/dsh-security scan --target /path/to/project
```

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · 网络与模型使用：| 检查 | 默认 | 网络 | 模型 Token |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 源码规则 | 开启 | 不联网（首次准备扫描器时需要下载） | 不需要 |
| 密钥检测 | 新任务开启 | 不联网 | 不需要 |
| 依赖漏洞 | 新任务开启 | 向 OSV 发送包名和版本，不发送源码 | 不需要 |
| 运行时检查 | 关闭；填写地址并确认授权后启用 | 只访问你填写的地址 | 不需要 |
| AI 复核 | 新任务开启 | 把选取的源码片段发给你在 DSH 中配置的模型 | 需要 |

CLI 和 Git hooks 不调用模型。插件不收集遥测，也不另存 API Key。报告里包含代码片段和漏洞位置，分享前请按项目的保密要求处理。

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · 效果与局限：在随包发布的 97 个合成样例上（46 个有漏洞、51 个安全），规则候选的精确率为 95.3%，召回率为 89.1%；逐例结果和复跑方法见[效果评测](evaluation/README.md)。样例与规则由同一作者编写，指标偏乐观，不代表真实项目的检出率。规则只做函数内分析，不跨函数或文件追踪；缺失授权、越权这类业务问题需要 AI 复核或人工判断。扫描结果是待核实的候选，本次未发现不等于没有漏洞。

真实安装与扫描已在 macOS arm64 上验证。macOS x64 和 Linux（glibc ≥ 2.34）有对应的扫描器发布包，但没有实机验收；Windows 不提供自动准备的扫描器。

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · DSH Security Scan：A security scanning workbench for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). It scans Python, Go and JavaScript/TypeScript projects, writes offline reports, hands selected findings to a DSH session for repair and rescans afterwards to confirm the result. Rule scans run locally and use no model tokens; AI review that traces the call chain is optional.

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · Features：- **Static scanning without model tokens**: 29 bundled Semgrep rules for Flask, Django, Express, Koa, Next.js, React, Gin, Echo, net/http and common SQL/HTTP libraries, covering command injection, SQL injection, XSS, SSRF, path traversal, open redirects, unsafe deserialization, disabled TLS verification and unverified JWTs.
- **Secrets and dependencies**: Gitleaks finds likely credentials; OSV reports known dependency advisories for npm/pnpm lockfiles, go.sum, requirements and uv.lock.
- **Read-only runtime check**: at most 12 same-origin GET requests against a URL you authorize, checking security headers, cookie flags, CORS, debug pages and exposed `.git` / `.env` files.
- **Optional AI review**: your configured DSH model reads source, traces callers, confirms or dismisses candidates and adds business risks such as missing authorization. Every conclusion cites lines it actually read.
- **Repair loop**: select findings in a report and send them to a DSH session, which by default fixes and verifies them on a separate branch, then rescans and shows what remains for the next round.

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · Install：Requires official DSH **0.2.1-rc.5**. Other versions have not been verified.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @shamcleren/dsh-security-scan@0.18.0
```

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · Install：You can also enter `@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan@0.18.0` under **Plugins → Add plugin** in the DSH sidebar. The command pins the version because the pnpm used by DSH does not pick versions published less than a day ago; to upgrade, use the newest version from the [releases](https://github.com/shamcleren/dsh-security-scan/releases). The npm package and the Release `.tgz` are the same file, so the Release URL also works. For the official desktop app, replace `web` with the `desktop` profile you use. Restart DSH and open **Security Scan** in the upper sidebar. On first use the plugin downloads and verifies Semgrep, Gitleaks and a private Python into `~/.dsh/security-scan/toolchains/` without changing the system environment.

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · First scan：1. Open **Security Scan** in the sidebar and create a task.
2. Choose a local directory or a Git repository and branch. For a rules-only scan without model tokens, turn off **Agentic AI**.
3. Save and run. Open the report from the report history, select findings and choose repair in a session or mark them as false positives.

You can also ask in a DSH session that has a project selected: “Use the security scan plugin to scan this project and review the candidates.” From the command line:

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · Network and model use：| Check | Default | Network | Model tokens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Source rules | On | None (scanner setup downloads once) | No |
| Secret detection | On for new tasks | None | No |
| Dependency advisories | On for new tasks | Sends package names and versions to OSV, never source | No |
| Runtime check | Off; enabled when you enter a URL and confirm authorization | Only the URL you enter | No |
| AI review | On for new tasks | Sends selected source excerpts to the model configured in DSH | Yes |

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · Network and model use：The CLI and Git hooks never call a model. The plugin sends no telemetry and stores no API keys. Reports contain code excerpts and vulnerability locations; handle them according to your project's confidentiality rules.

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · Results and limits：On the 97 bundled synthetic cases (46 vulnerable, 51 safe), rule candidates reach 95.3% precision and 89.1% recall; see the [evaluation](evaluation/README.md) for per-case results and how to reproduce them. The same author wrote the cases and the rules, so the figures are optimistic and do not describe detection rates on real projects. Rules analyze one function at a time and do not follow values across functions or files; missing authorization and similar business logic issues need AI review or a human. Findings are candidates to verify, and a clean scan does not prove the absence of vulnerabilities.

@shamcleren/dsh-security-scan README · Results and limits：Installation and scanning are verified on macOS arm64. Scanner packages exist for macOS x64 and Linux (glibc 2.34 or later) but have not been tested on real machines; Windows has no managed scanner setup.
